sources.per_run_files: <set>/runs/<arm>/R/<name>/{traj.npz (inference_states, measured_qpos, executed_actions, chunk_start_steps), frames.jsonl (planning: actions_reference, object_poses; control: applied_ctrl), manifest.json}; <set>/replay/<arm>_R_<name>.npz (target_pos, crate_pos/quat, tcp)
sources.dataset: /mnt/dev/AG3S_VLA-storage/datasets/rby1/rby1_randomized_pick_place_16d_v1 (data/chunk-000/episode_%06d.parquet observation.state, phase_index; meta/randomized_episodes.jsonl events, basket_pose, final_fruit_poses, episode_length)
sources.client_state_mapping: /mnt/dev/AG3S_VLA-development/integration/rby1/bringup/pi05_infer.py build_obs rby1_16d branch (lines ~464-490) and rby1_state (~1658); traj.npz inference_states = obs['state'] (line ~1980)

state_used: traj.npz inference_states (exact obs['state'] sent to the policy); consistency vs measured_qpos[t_step-1] (same mapping): max abs diff over all chunks of all 89 runs = 0.0

exploratory_definitions.E1: motion-onset step of each proposal (actions_reference, used arm 7): first k with max_j|a_k-a_0| > 0.05 rad; None (plotted/aggregated as 50) if never
exploratory_definitions.E2: per-dim |policy-input state - NN demo frame| at the first post-P chunk (M1 primary NN)
exploratory_definitions.E3: demo still rows: frames from release_start (release_end) until used arm moves > 0.05 rad
exploratory_definitions.E4: distinct trajectories: identical (episode, seed, t_P, release_row, first post-P state) -> same trajectory (CL2 C1a / CL3 C1a / CL3 C1aF1 etc. replicate)
exploratory_definitions.E5: arm_5 of the policy-input state at the chunk at/before first gripper-close row, release row, t_P vs demo arm_5; 8D NN distance before first close / at release
exploratory_definitions.E6: for planning rows 150 <= t_step <= t_P: max |actions - actions_reference| over the executed 8 steps on used arm_5 and on the 7 used joints; policy reference arm_5 at the last chunk at/before t_P

deviations_from_prereg: M1(a)-(e) were computed exactly; in the figure panel (a) the y value is jittered +-0.25 per run for visibility (stated in the sidecar)
E1-E6 are exploratory, added after the pre-registered numbers were seen (E2 because the M1 NN distance of NR runs was large; E5/E6 because E2 showed arm_5 dominates)
not_measured: no policy-internal quantity (attention, features, action-expert internals); why the proposals defer motion is not measured
no image input analysis: the policy also sees 3 camera images; the records hold no images (only third_person_front.mp4), so image-vs-state attribution is not possible from records

no counterfactual (state or image swap) and no policy-only (no TO) closed loop: every arm in CL2/CL3/T53 runs with TO (C0 = V11AB + TO); E6 measures only per-chunk TO deltas, not the cumulative effect of TO on the states the policy later saw
independence: 27 NR runs = 19 distinct trajectories (CL2 C1a / CL3 C1a / C1aF1 replicate exactly); 24/27 in 3 episodes; ep3 NR is 1 distinct trajectory and R_ep3 is 1 run, so no tests were run
demo nearest-neighbour uses only the same episode's demo (310 frames), not the whole training set
gripper 'measured' is |gripper qpos|/0.045 at the end of the row (rby1_state), not finger contact or force
